_README: Hand-curated gold labels, keyed on the 8-char correlation prefix used throughout
NOTES_running_fixloop(10).md. Consumed by cmd/reasoningset via --labels.
WHY HAND-CURATED, NOT PARSED: there is exactly ONE RUBRIC_*.md in the repo, and
~21 lines in a 141KB notes file carry a grade, in at least four incompatible prose
shapes (a prospective grading key; two markdown tables with DIFFERENT columns;
inline bolded prose; a narrative run-ledger carrying several runs at once). The
value vocabulary is open ('partial', '**PASS, CITED**', '**FAIL - and actively
dismissed**', 'not reached', 'abstained (neutral)'). Worst of all, several uses of
FAILED mean an API 529 or a lost spawn, NOT a rubric grade - a regex would
confidently mislabel those as negatives, which is the one error a benchmark cannot
absorb. Enumerating them by hand is faster and correct.
COMPLETE as of 2026-07-20 for NOTES_running_fixloop(10).md, which is the only file
carrying grades (NOTES(9) predates the discipline and has none; the SUMMARY has no
per-run table). 12 runs curated. Re-read the notes if new runs are graded.
THREE KINDS OF LABEL, deliberately kept apart:
benchmark_grade  PASS|PARTIAL|FAIL   graded against a rubric PRE-REGISTERED
before dispatch. null when no rubric grade
exists - including every infrastructure
failure. Never infer FAIL from a bad outcome.
subsystem_grade  PASS|FAIL           a grade on a MECHANISM (the code-lookup tier,
the council) exercised by that run, NOT on the
diagnosis. Kept separate so it cannot be
mistaken for reasoning quality.
terminal         how the run ended, including the honest non-answers.
THE ABSTENTIONS ARE POSITIVES. 5120c0dc and b606dbf6 both refused to answer, and
both are graded PASS: one because a confident half-answer would have shipped to a
fixer, one because the symptom it was given embedded unevidenced empirical claims
and cite-or-abstain correctly refused them. A reasoning model should learn to
abstain; these are the hard positive examples, not the failures.
TWO RUNS PRODUCED NO RECORDS AND THAT IS CORRECT: 32c1e88f never started, and
80c35dea's child orchestration row was never created (zero LLM calls). They are
listed so their absence reads as documented rather than as a gap in this file.
BLINDING: this file is never concatenated into input_state. It ships separately
and joins at emit time, so the corpus cannot leak the benchmark's own answers.
